portInfo.description: Jeddah is Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea commercial and cultural hub and the traditional maritime gateway toward Makkah and Madinah. Cruise guests reach the city after clearing through Jeddah Islamic Port, which Cruise Saudi and MedCruise describe as the Kingdom’s primary cruise homeport with a single cruise quay sized to 365 m / 11 m draught. Visit Saudi’s Jeddah destination page frames coastal experiences and top attractions for leisure visitors. This guide focuses on the city call experience; facility engineering details stay on jeddah-islamic-port-saudi-arabia to avoid duplicated berth claims.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Al-Balad (Historic Jeddah) — UNESCO-listed Hijazi architecture — ~150 min.
Art / contemporary districts — check Visit Saudi listings.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Keep passport/visa status compatible with any inland religious-site visits; follow line briefings.
